sentences.english: I had cereal for breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 我早餐吃了麦片。

sentences.english: I skipped breakfast this morning, so I'm already starving and it's only ten o'clock.
sentences.chinese: 我今天早上没吃早饭，才十点我就饿坏了。

sentences.english: On Sundays, my dad makes a huge breakfast with pancakes, scrambled eggs, and bacon, and we all sit around the table talking and laughing for an hour.
sentences.chinese: 星期天，我爸会做一顿丰盛的早餐，有煎饼、炒蛋和培根，我们全家人围坐在餐桌旁有说有笑地聊上一个小时。

sentences.english: What time do we leave?
sentences.chinese: 我们几点出发？

sentences.english: It's almost time to go; grab your jacket and let's head out the door.
sentences.chinese: 差不多该走了，拿上你的外套，我们出门吧。

sentences.english: I can't believe how much time we wasted sitting in traffic — we could have taken the back roads and been here an hour ago.
sentences.chinese: 真不敢相信我们在堵车上浪费了这么多时间，要是走小路，我们一个小时前就该到了。

sentences.english: I need to buy some bread.
sentences.chinese: 我需要买点面包。

sentences.english: Can you pick up a loaf of bread on your way home from work?
sentences.chinese: 你下班回家路上能顺便带一条面包回来吗？

sentences.english: My grandmother used to bake fresh bread every Saturday morning, and the whole house would smell amazing for the rest of the day.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶以前每个星期六早上都会烤新鲜面包，接下来一整天整个房子都香得不得了。

sentences.english: I want an egg for breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 我早餐想吃个鸡蛋。

sentences.english: Be careful with those eggs — they're organic and cost me a fortune at the farmer's market.
sentences.chinese: 小心那些鸡蛋，它们是有机的，我在农贸市场花了大价钱买的。

sentences.english: I tried to flip an egg without breaking the yolk this morning, and I actually did it perfectly for the first time in my life, so I had to take a picture.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我试着翻鸡蛋不弄破蛋黄，结果我有生以来第一次完美做到了，所以必须拍张照留念。

sentences.english: We're out of milk again.
sentences.chinese: 我们又没牛奶了。

sentences.english: I poured milk into my coffee, only to realize it had gone sour and the whole cup was ruined.
sentences.chinese: 我把牛奶倒进咖啡里，才发现牛奶酸了，整杯咖啡都毁了。

sentences.english: I used to hate drinking milk as a kid, but my mom would make me finish a whole glass before I could leave the table, and now I actually love it.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候特别讨厌喝牛奶，但我妈非要我喝完一整杯才能离开餐桌，结果现在我居然真爱上了喝牛奶。

sentences.english: I love chicken noodle soup.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢鸡汤面条。

sentences.english: There's a tiny noodle shop near my office that makes the most amazing hand-pulled noodles.
sentences.chinese: 我办公室附近有家小面馆，做的拉面好吃极了。

sentences.english: Whenever I'm feeling under the weather, I make myself a huge bowl of spicy noodle soup with vegetables and a soft-boiled egg, and it always makes me feel better.
sentences.chinese: 每当我觉得不舒服的时候，就会给自己做一大碗香辣汤面，加上蔬菜和一个溏心蛋，吃完总能感觉好很多。

sentences.english: Can I have some apple juice?
sentences.chinese: 我能喝点苹果汁吗？

sentences.english: I spilled orange juice all over the kitchen floor this morning, and my socks are still sticky.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我把橙汁洒了一厨房地板，我的袜子现在还粘乎乎的。

sentences.english: I bought a juicer last month thinking I'd make fresh juice every day, but honestly, cleaning the machine takes so long that I've only used it twice.
sentences.chinese: 上个月我买了台榨汁机，想着天天榨新鲜果汁喝，但说实话，清洗机器太费时间了，我到现在只用过两次。

sentences.english: We're having rice for dinner.
sentences.chinese: 我们晚饭吃米饭。

sentences.english: I accidentally added too much water to the rice, so it turned into a sticky mess.
sentences.chinese: 我不小心在米饭里加了太多水，结果煮成了一团粘糊糊的东西。

sentences.english: My mom taught me how to make fried rice using leftover rice from the night before, and now it's my favorite quick meal when I don't feel like cooking something fancy.
sentences.chinese: 我妈教我用前一天晚上的剩饭做炒饭，现在当我不想做什么大餐时，这已经成了我最喜欢的快手饭。

sentences.english: I don't eat meat on Fridays.
sentences.chinese: 我星期五不吃肉。

sentences.english: The meat at that BBQ place is so tender it practically falls off the bone.
sentences.chinese: 那家烧烤店的肉嫩得几乎脱骨。

sentences.english: I'm trying to cut down on meat and eat more plant-based meals, but it's hard when my roommate brings home burgers that smell incredible.
sentences.chinese: 我在努力少吃肉，多吃素食，但室友带回家的汉堡闻起来香得要命，实在太难抵挡了。

sentences.english: Eat your vegetables, please.
sentences.chinese: 请把你的蔬菜吃了。

sentences.english: I planted tomatoes and lettuce in my garden, so I'll have fresh vegetables all summer long.
sentences.chinese: 我在园子里种了西红柿和生菜，这样整个夏天都有新鲜蔬菜吃了。

sentences.english: I wasn't a big fan of vegetables as a kid, but once I learned to roast them with olive oil and garlic, I realized I actually love the taste and texture.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候不太爱吃蔬菜，但当我学会用橄榄油和大蒜烤蔬菜后，才发现自己其实很喜欢那个味道和口感。

sentences.english: An apple is a healthy snack.
sentences.chinese: 苹果是健康的零食。

sentences.english: I'm trying to keep my meals healthy, but these cookies are testing my willpower.
sentences.chinese: 我想保持健康饮食，但这些饼干正在考验我的意志力。

sentences.english: It's important to find a balance between eating healthy food and enjoying the things you love, because life's too short to never eat pizza again.
sentences.chinese: 在吃健康食物和享受喜爱的东西之间找到平衡很重要，因为人生苦短，总不能永远不再吃披萨吧。

sentences.english: Put it on the blue plate.
sentences.chinese: 把它放在蓝色盘子上。

sentences.english: My plate was piled so high with food at the potluck that I could barely carry it.
sentences.chinese: 在百乐餐上，我盘子里的食物堆得太高了，差点都端不动。

sentences.english: I dropped a plate while doing the dishes last night, and it shattered into a million pieces right as my dog ran through the kitchen, which gave me a heart attack.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚洗碗时我打碎了一个盘子，它碎成了无数片，恰好我家的狗从厨房跑过，把我吓得心脏都快停了。

sentences.english: This soup is really hot.
sentences.chinese: 这汤真烫。

sentences.english: I made a big pot of chicken soup for my neighbor because she's been feeling sick all week.
sentences.chinese: 我给邻居煮了一大锅鸡汤，因为她整整一周都在生病。

sentences.english: Nothing beats a warm bowl of soup on a cold rainy day, especially when you can hear the rain tapping against the window while you're wrapped in a blanket.
sentences.chinese: 冷雨天，什么也比不上一碗热汤，尤其是当你裹着毯子，还能听到雨点打在窗户上的声音。

sentences.english: I need more fruit in my diet.
sentences.chinese: 我的饮食中需要更多水果。

sentences.english: The fruit stand on the corner has the sweetest strawberries I've ever tasted in my life.
sentences.chinese: 街角的水果摊有我这辈子吃过最甜的草莓。

sentences.english: For dessert, my mom always puts out a big bowl of fresh fruit, and even though it's not chocolate cake, we all end up eating the whole thing because it's just that good.
sentences.chinese: 甜点时间，我妈总会端出一大碗新鲜水果，虽然那不是巧克力蛋糕，但好吃得我们每次都会把它全部吃完。

chinese_meaning: 色彩缤纷的；五彩缤纷的

sentences.english: Her dress is so colourful!
sentences.chinese: 她的裙子好鲜艳！

sentences.english: We painted the kids' room in bright, colourful colors to make it feel more cheerful.
sentences.chinese: 我们用明亮鲜艳的颜色粉刷了孩子的房间，让它感觉更欢快。

sentences.english: The market was so colourful with all the fresh flowers, fruits, and handmade crafts that I couldn't stop taking photos even though my phone storage was almost full.
sentences.chinese: 市场上到处是鲜花、水果和手工艺品，五彩缤纷的，即使手机存储快满了，我还是忍不住一直拍照。

sentences.english: No candy before dinner.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭前不准吃糖。

sentences.english: My little brother traded his entire sandwich for a piece of candy at school today.
sentences.chinese: 我弟弟今天在学校用整个三明治换了一块糖。

sentences.english: I still have a soft spot for the candy I used to eat as a kid, and sometimes when I see those colorful little packs at the checkout, I can't help throwing one in the cart.
sentences.chinese: 我依然对小时候吃的那种糖果情有独钟，有时在收银台看到那些彩色小包装，就忍不住往购物车里扔一包。

sentences.english: This pizza is so yummy!
sentences.chinese: 这个披萨好好吃！

sentences.english: My grandma makes the yummiest chocolate chip cookies I've ever had in my entire life.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶做的巧克力豆饼干是我这辈子吃过最好吃的。

sentences.english: I tried this new ice cream flavor last night — it was called caramel brownie blast and it was so yummy that I nearly ate the whole pint in one sitting while watching my favorite show.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚我试了一款新口味的冰淇淋，叫焦糖布朗尼风暴，好吃到我看最爱剧集的时候差点一口气把整整一品脱全吃光了。
